mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.sync_alert(job_code,run_id,category,severity,dedup_key,summary) values (#{jobCode},#{runId},#{category},'ERROR',#{dedupKey},#{summary}) on conflict(dedup_key) do update set run_id=excluded.run_id,summary=excluded.summary,last_seen_at=clock_timestamp(), first_seen_at=case when integration_schema.sync_alert.status='RESOLVED' then clock_timestamp() else integration_schema.sync_alert.first_seen_at end, occurrence_count=case when integration_schema.sync_alert.status='RESOLVED' then 1 else integration_schema.sync_alert.occurrence_count+1 end, status=case when integration_schema.sync_alert.status='RESOLVED' then 'OPEN' else integration_schema.sync_alert.status end
mapper.update: update integration_schema.sync_alert set status='RESOLVED' where job_code=#{jobCode} and category in ('SYNC_FAILURE','STALE')
update integration_schema.sync_alert set status='RESOLVED' where job_code=#{jobCode} and category='RECONCILIATION'
mapper.select: select c.job_code from integration_schema.sync_checkpoint c join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) where d.enabled=true and ((c.job_code='SAP_COST_CENTER_DELTA' and coalesce(c.last_success_at,to_timestamp(0))<clock_timestamp()-interval '30 minutes') or (c.job_code='SAP_EXCHANGE_RATE_DELTA' and (clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::time>=time '03:00' and (c.last_success_at is null or (c.last_success_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date<(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date)))
select count(*) from integration_schema.sync_alert where status<>'RESOLVED'
select * from integration_schema.sync_alert order by (status='RESOLVED'),last_seen_at desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
mapper.update: update integration_schema.sync_alert set status='ACKNOWLEDGED' where id=#{id} and status='OPEN'
